title.zh: 使法律修订版生效的命令
title.en: Order Bringing the Revised Edition of Acts Into Force

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 7)
Order Bringing the Revised Edition of Acts Into Force
O 1
G.N. No. S 93/1987
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
[30th March 1987]
WHEREAS a Revised Edition of the Acts of the Republic of Singapore in force on 31st December 1986 has been prepared pursuant to the provisions of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act 1983:
AND WHEREAS it is enacted by section 7 of the Act that, upon the completion of the Revised Edition of Acts, the Law Revision Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of the Revised Edition of Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, provide that the Revised Edition of Acts shall come into force on such date as he may think fit:
NOW THEREFORE it is hereby ordered by the President that the Revised Edition of Acts shall come into force on 30th March 1987.
